subject.title: feat: add generic Project Record edit annotations

question: Should ProjectRecord annotations become a supported permanent public Astro contract for site-owned edit metadata?
rationale: The implementation adds exported types and an optional renderer prop; repository policy requires explicit Bobby approval before merge, and source review cannot choose that API direction.

options.title: Sponsor the generic annotation contract
options.body: Approve the data-only annotations as a public contract after the contributor adds redacted real-setup proof of the fixture behavior.

options.title: Keep the existing slot-only surface
options.body: Decline the new annotation API and keep site customization on the current documented renderer and slot contracts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic annotation contract
recommendation.body: Approve the data-only annotations as a public contract after the contributor adds redacted real-setup proof of the fixture behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: AGENTS.md assigns Bobby the explicit merge approval gate for this repository.
